As we approach the bar,
I notice familiar silhouettes from afar.
As we get closer, I realize who it is I'm looking at.
... Cafe Sweety?

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Only one person would address us with such a sweet voice.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: What? Don't be ridicu...

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Wha?! Pal?

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: I never thought I'd see you here!

lines.speaker: frima
lines.text: Hey. Tired.
So you all are participating as well?

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: This could be an excellent opportunity to give Black Typhoon a new makeover.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: We already agreed that we'd make a sparring arena inside the cafe.

lines.speaker: frima
lines.text: No. King-sized Bed.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Oh gosh, here we go again...

lines.speaker: frima
lines.text: Me. Leader.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: You may be the squad leader, but I'm the team leader for this event.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Huh? I thought I was the team leader.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Bummer.

lines.speaker: frima
lines.text: Me. Leader.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Argh, I can't with you two!

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: Um, excuse me...

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: What? What do you want?

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: Um...

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: C-Can you tell me what you're drinking?

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: It looks delicious, hehe...

lines.speaker: alice_b
lines.text: Yeah, they don't look sour at all.

lines.speaker: alice_b
lines.text: They smell super sweet.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Very nice.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: You two have a good eye for quality.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: I'm drinking Sugar Coffee with just the right amount of sugar added.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: What are you talking about? They're clearly asking about the Milk Coffee I'm drinking.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: The milk is what gives it that creamy smoothness.

lines.speaker: frima
lines.text: Cream coffee. Lots of cream.

lines.speaker: frima
lines.text: Sweet. Smooth. The best.

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: Uh...

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: I-I think I'll try the Cream Coffee.

lines.speaker: frima
lines.text: Good choice.

lines.speaker: alice_b
lines.text: I'm a big fan of dairy,

lines.speaker: alice_b
lines.text: so I'll go for a Milk Coffee!

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Very smart! Here you are.
Er... I think I'll try the Sugar Coffee.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: I knew I could count on your impeccable taste,

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Partner.
*Sip*
... Blech.
As I thought, it's sickeningly sweet.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: By the way, Partner.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Are you teamed up with these two?
Yes, that's right.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Is that so?

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: The thrill of competition, where men and women go head-to-head in close quarters...

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: How exciting!

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Well, we have no intention of pulling any punches, so this competition will be done fair and square.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: The three of you will have to bring your A game.

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: ... H-huh?

lines.speaker: alice_b
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: alice_b
lines.text: We're here to win, after all!

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Very nice. I like your determination.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: You must be the team leader.

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: Um, actually...

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: I'm the team leader.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Oh, really?

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Then you have to be more confident!

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: You can't be shriveling in the corner like that.

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: Er... okay...
Although Cafe Sweety may first appear quite chaotic,
they are highly proficient at problem-solving and thinking on their feet.
Also, Soda appears more deflated than usual, so we have to stay on our toes.
How about we head back to the first floor?

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: Sure, I suppose...

lines.speaker: alice_b
lines.text: Sounds good!

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Are you all heading back down?
Yeah. Thanks for the coffee.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: If I drink from the same cup that you took a sip from...

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: would that be considered as indirect kissing?

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Would you shut your yap?

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Anyway, see you all later.

lines.speaker: frima
lines.text: Zzz...
As we wrap up our initial exploration of Coin Rush,
we head back to the main hall on the first floor.
Soda, are you okay?

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: Oh, yeah! Of course!

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: Coin Rush sure seems like a fun and exciting place. And so big!

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: Thanks for accompanying me, you guys!

lines.speaker: alice_b
lines.text: I had fun too!

lines.speaker: alice_b
lines.text: I'm still a bit bummed that I didn't get to see the black and white bunnies.

lines.speaker: alice_b
lines.text: I thought for sure we'd run into one of them.

lines.speaker: alice_b
lines.text: *Sob*

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: Hold on...

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: I think I see bunny ears in front of the stage over there...

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: Do you think it might be them?

lines.speaker: alice_b
lines.text: Huh?! Where?

lines.speaker: alice_b
lines.text: Oh my gosh, you're right!

lines.speaker: alice_b
lines.text: It's them!
Alice breaks into a run.
I follow Alice, thinking that Blanc and Noir must have arrived...
... Huh?
Much to my surprise,
it is Folkwang and Mary who are dressed up as bunnies.
